news.headline: CloudNC raises $20M to automate manufacturing’s most pressing bottlenecks
news.summary: UK manufacturing software startup CloudNC just locked in $20M in fresh funding, pushing its total raised to $128M. The company automates manufacturing bottlenecks—a critical pain point for the sector that's increasingly turning to software solutions to boost efficiency and cut costs.

news.headline: ‘Gambling with our lives’: Anthropic researcher quits, warns against self-improving AI
news.summary: Anthropic researcher Jacob Coxon walked away from his role, warning that self-improving AI poses existential risks and urging the industry to adopt pacing agreements. His departure signals growing internal concern at major AI labs about the speed of capability advancement outpacing safety measures.

educational.title: Bull Market vs. Bear Market — What the Terms Actually Mean
points: A bull market is a sustained rise in prices; a bear market is a sustained fall
The common threshold: a 20%+ drop from a recent high defines a bear market
Bull markets historically last far longer than bear markets on average
Investor psychology often overshoots in both directions — greed, then fear
Long-term investors are taught to expect both phases, not just the good one
